cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
live=json.load(open("nm_live.json"))
liveset={r[0] for r in live}
# tambah 3 key baru yang sudah diverifikasi
new=["nmk_live_Tv78qqiEcF3Tb6u2kC5WPRuhWT5MDti94RVaZVQT",
     "nmk_live_FtVn4vczCTzAEeZYSQYF65DSwerrKBsPbuAQJx1l",
     "nmk_live_pZuW9YnhsUNiNy4P14yUcK5ljBLonvvKPyX8LkL6"]
seen=set(); allk=[]
for f in ["nomask_live_keys.txt","nm2_api.txt"]:
    for l in open(f):
        m=re.search(r"(nmk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]+)",l)
        if m and m.group(1) not in seen:
            seen.add(m.group(1)); allk.append((m.group(1), l.split("|")[0].strip()))
liveall=[(k,e) for k,e in allk if k in liveset or k in new]
dead=[(k,e) for k,e in allk if k not in liveset and k not in new]
with open("nomask_live_keys.txt","w") as f:
    f.write("# nomask — AUDIT 2026-11-17 (base: https://api.nomask.ai/v1)\n")
    f.write("# format: email | api_key | status   (ganti ke nomor berikutnya saat HTTP 402)\n")
    f.write("# BARU (hasil batch, terverifikasi): nomor 20-22\n")
    for i,(k,e) in enumerate(liveall,1):
        tag=" | BARU" if k in new else ""
        f.write(f"{i:2d}. {e} | {k} | LIVE{tag}\n")
    f.write("# --- HABIS (402) ---\n")
    for k,e in dead: f.write(f" -- {e} | {k} | HABIS\n")
print("LIVE:",len(liveall),"| HABIS:",len(dead))
